name: gemini-video-backend
description: Backend API for Gemini AI Slideshow Video Generator

scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,magenta" "ts-node-dev --respawn --transpile-only --ignore-watch frontend src/server.ts" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.start:prod: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node dist/server.js
scripts.start:dev: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=development node dist/server.js
